concepts.explanation: p and q are constants, so they remain as coefficients when differentiating with respect to x.
A known point on a parameterised curve gives one equation linking the unknown parameters.
To determine two unknown parameters, we need two independent conditions. The point condition supplies one; the derivative or normal information supplies the other.
